{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Seafood|Seafood]]

This is a simple recipe that takes no more than 40 minutes from fridge to table.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Salmon|salmon]] fillet (whatever size you like)
* 3 parts [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 2 parts coarse-grained [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F/180°C.
# Wash and pat dry the salmon fillet. Remove the pin bones (if there are any), and cut salmon into portions if desired.
# Mix honey and mustard, and adjust mixture to taste.
# Spread mixture generously over and under the salmon.
# Cook in oven on top rack for about 15–18 minutes (depending on how you like your salmon cooked).
# Finish under [[Cookbook:Broiling|broiler]] for 2–3 minutes, but remove before glaze starts to char.
